_doc: Server-side catalog for Stripe → Mindbody checkout (one-time AND recurring). NEVER trust price/serviceId from the browser; this file is the source of truth. One-time SKUs (kind: newClient/dropin/packs) flow through Stripe Checkout → CheckoutShoppingCart with Type:Service. Recurring memberships (kind: monthlyMembership, stripeMode: subscription) flow through Stripe Subscription → invoice.paid webhook → CheckoutShoppingCart with Type:Service per renewal. Mindbody Contracts (PurchaseContract endpoint) are NOT used in the Stripe recurring path — see docs/MEMBERSHIP-RECURRING-CHECKOUT.md.
_pinnedAgainstStudio: AMARÉ Wellness Studio. One-time Pricing Option ids pulled via `npm run stripe:find-mb-ids` on 2026-05-11. Recurring membership Pricing Option ids (100133/100134/100135) created 2026-05-14 specifically for the Stripe recurring sync path; the legacy ids (100129/100130/100056) are kept untouched for the existing Mindbody Classic /sale/purchase-contract flow. Bring-a-Friend Guest Pass Pricing Option **100136** (`Guest Pass - 1 Class`) created 2026-05-27 — see docs/bring-a-friend-guest-pass-plan.md. Re-run that script if studio renames or repackages.

items._note: Stripe Subscription → Mindbody Service-per-renewal path (Option A). On checkout: store SubscriptionRecord + agreement consent. On invoice.paid: add this Pricing Option (Sell-online disabled — staff bearer bypass). On invoice.payment_failed / subscription.deleted: stop adding. Mindbody PurchaseContract endpoint is NOT called. Disabled until ENABLE_STRIPE_RECURRING_CHECKOUT=1. Cancellation is admin-only in V1; Stripe Customer Portal cancel must be disabled in Stripe Dashboard.
